name: Sunlite Recycling Industries Ltd
about: Founded in 2012, Sunlite Recycling Industries manufactures copper rods, wires, conductors, and earthing materials from recycled copper scrap.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] Co. manufactures copper rods & wires, copper earthing wires, copper earthing strips, copper conductors, copper wire bars, etc. through recycling of copper scrap, which has electrical and mechanical properties suitable for applications in power generation, transmission, distribution, and electronic industries.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
